title: Mystic Crystal Ball
description: A large transparent crystal ball sits on an ornate metallic pedestal atop a wooden surface. Inside the sphere, a surreal night scene unfolds with a glowing golden heart at the center emitting neon pink, yellow, and blue branches, symbols including fleur-de-lis, hearts, moons, and lanterns, a silhouetted figure in a boat, and dripping paint effects along the bottom.
prompt: A surreal glowing crystal ball on a metallic stand, transparent sphere filled with a vibrant night scene featuring a bright golden heart at the center radiating neon pink, yellow, and blue branching energy, scattered purple fleur-de-lis, hearts, moons, lanterns, and a silhouetted person rowing a boat under a yellow moon, dripping pink paint from the bottom of the orb, set against a starry twilight sky, magical atmosphere, detailed digital painting
